resources.string: This app reads only your payment-confirmation SMS and reports it to your business, so paid orders are marked paid without you doing anything.
Why this app needs SMS access

It reads ONLY messages from bKash, Nagad and Upay. It sends the payment details (amount, transaction id, sender, time) of those messages to your business server. It NEVER reads or sends any of your other SMS. You can turn this off any time in Settings.
Grant SMS access so payment confirmations can be captured. Only provider messages are ever read.
Permission is required to capture payments. Open settings to allow it.
